d2-1: The angry father jabs his finger and shouts, robes swaying; the small boy stands perfectly still and calm, looking up at him; cows shift behind, dust drifting in golden light, slow push-in.
d2-2: The small boy walks barefoot away from camera down the torch-lit road toward the dark palace, torch flames flickering, his shadow stretching, slow follow behind him.
d2-3: The boy sits still on the doorstep as star trails wheel slowly across the night sky above, the oil lamp flame flickering beside him, his calm face lit warm; very slow push-in.
d2-4: Yama slowly opens his hands to offer heaps of gold that glint and spill; horses toss their heads behind him; the boy shakes his head no; slow push-in.
d2-5: A ripple of golden light pulses outward from Yama's raised hand and washes over the boy, whose eyes widen in wonder; light particles drift; slow push-in.
d2-6: At the home shrine at dawn the grandmother lights the lamp, the flame catching; the teen and girl bring their palms together; soft morning light grows; gentle slow drift.
d3-1: The king's elephant strides forward into the hermitage, banners rippling, the army moving behind; the sage bows with palms together; leaves fall; slow push-in.
d3-2: Steam rises from endless brass pots as more food appears; the glowing white cow blinks calmly; soldiers reach for food, amazed; lamp flames flicker; slow pan.
d3-3: The kneeling king gestures toward the chests of gold and the cow; the sage slowly raises his hand and shakes his head; the cow flicks her ear; slow push-in.
d3-4: The sage lifts his glowing staff higher and the light flares; broken spears and arrows clatter to the ground at his feet; the stunned king lowers his sword; dust swirls.
d3-5: The man meditates perfectly still while blossoms and snowflakes drift past him from the tree, the sun rising over the mountains, his hair stirring in the wind; slow push-in.
d3-6: Morning sunlight slowly spreads across the room; the teenage girl and her grandfather sit with eyes closed and palms together, breathing calmly; dust motes float; slow push-in.
d4-1: Two vast armies face each other at dawn, banners whipping in the wind, dust rolling across the plain, conch shells raised; slow aerial push between the lines.
d4-2: The prince lifts the golden breastplate off over his head and sets it down beside his weapons; his brothers watch, worried; his cloak moves in the wind; slow push-in.
d4-3: The prince walks away from camera, unarmed and barefoot, down the long empty ground between the armies, cloak flowing, dust lifting at each step; slow follow behind.
d4-4: The prince bows lower to touch the old warrior's feet; the old man rests his hand on his head in blessing, tears in his eyes; soldiers behind slowly lower their spears.
d4-5: Close on the hands pressed together in namaste; the warm light between the palms slowly brightens and glows; the cloth behind ripples gently.
d4-6: At the apartment door the teenage boy brings his palms together in namaste and the grandmother returns it with a big smile; the marigold garland sways; slow push-in.
d5-1: The gods cheer and raise their arms in victory, Indra lifts his thunderbolt which crackles with light, Agni's flame hair roars; clouds roll; slow push-in.
d5-2: The tall being of white light shimmers and pulses between the trees; the gods turn and step back in surprise; light rays sweep through the forest; slow push-in.
d5-3: Agni throws out his arms and flames burst from his hair and hands, chest out, boasting; the being of light stays perfectly still; sparks swirl.
d5-4: A roaring wall of fire swirls and crashes around the single green blade of grass, which stays perfectly still and untouched; very slow push-in on the grass.
d5-5: The goddess in the sky slowly extends her hand, golden light radiating from her; the humbled gods below bow their heads; clouds drift; slow tilt down.
d5-6: The father moves the brass arti lamp in a slow circle before the shrine, the five flames trailing light; the teens hold their palms over the flames, smiling softly.
d6-1: The younger scholar jabs his finger and challenges; the calm sage smiles slightly and answers with a small gesture; the old king leans forward on his throne; lamps flicker.
d6-2: Thousands of small shining divine figures on clouds stretch to the horizon and slowly drift and glow; golden light pulses; slow upward tilt.
d6-3: The circle of gods on lotus seats glows brighter, lotuses gently opening, divine light pulsing softly; slow push-in.
d6-4: The gods' outlines slowly melt and merge into one vast soft golden light at the center that grows brighter and fills the frame.
d6-5: The old sage writes slowly on the palm leaf with his stylus, the glow around the leaf brightening; morning mist drifts over the mountains; slow push-in.
d6-6: The teenage girl reaches out and places the flower before the small Krishna, smiling; her grandmother watches, beaming; lamp flames flicker; slow push-in.
d7-1: The robber leaps out from behind the tree with his club raised; the frightened travelers recoil; the bullock rears its head; dust kicks up; quick push-in.
d7-2: The calm sage raises his hand gently and speaks; the robber slowly lowers his club, puzzled; the veena strings shimmer; leaves drift down; slow push-in.
d7-3: In the lamp-lit hut the wife and old parents turn away shaking their heads; the robber's face falls in shock; the lamp flame flickers; slow push-in.
d7-4: The kneeling robber listens as the sage leans down and softly speaks into his ear; dawn light rises through the trees; the club lies on the ground; slow push-in.
d7-5: The man sits perfectly still as the earthen anthill slowly rises around his body; leaves fall and seasons of light shift around him; slow push-in.
d7-6: The white-bearded poet writes on palm leaves by the river at sunrise; two birds fly overhead; the river glitters; slow push-in.
d7-7: The teenage boy jogs up and holds out the dropped wallet; the old man turns, surprised, and takes it gratefully; traffic lights blur past; slow push-in.
d1-1: Through the taxi windscreen the city lights stream past and blur; the small Ganesha idol on the dashboard stays still in sharp focus, marigolds swaying slightly.
d1-2: The shopkeeper pushes the shutter fully up and touches his forehead before the Ganesha picture; the lamp flame flickers; dawn light spills in; slow push-in.
d1-3: Marigold petals drift down onto the invitation card; the wedding lights behind twinkle and glow; slow push-in.
d1-4: Ganesha writes quickly with his broken tusk, the palm-leaf pages filling and turning; the lamp flames flicker; slow push-in.
d1-5: Ganesha raises his hand in blessing, golden light radiating outward; lamps flicker and marigolds sway; slow push-in.
d1-6: The young woman touches the Ganesha idol on the dashboard, then turns the key with a smile at her mother; evening light flares through the windscreen.
